freePlan.limits: Houdini Apprentice: non-commercial use only, near-full feature access, watermarked renders and file format restricted to Apprentice-only files.

keyLimits.en: Free, non-commercial use only; renders carry a watermark; access to nearly all Houdini FX features.
Annual license priced at $299/year (or $449 for a 2-year term); limited to 3 licenses per commercial entity.
Only for commercial/contracting entities with annual gross revenue under $100,000 USD and under $1,000,000 USD in total funding raised in the last 24 months.
Includes Houdini Engine Indie and SideFX Labs production tools at no extra cost.
No public price shown on the Houdini Core product page; purchase/licensing requires going through the Buy flow or contacting SideFX. Limited to 5 workstation licenses per studio.
Full VFX and animation capabilities; no public price shown on the fetched pages; limited to 5 workstation licenses per studio.

cautions.en: Houdini Indie is only available to entities under $100K annual revenue and under $1M total funding raised; a growing studio will eventually need to move to Core or FX at unpublished, higher prices.

capabilities.en: Procedural modeling, rigging and animation workflows built around a node-based system.
VFX simulation tools for particles, dynamics, fluids and terrain generation.
Built-in Karma XPU renderer plus support for third-party renderers including RenderMan, Arnold, Redshift, V-Ray, 3Delight and OctaneRender.
Houdini Engine plugin for integrating Houdini's procedural assets into other DCC and game-engine pipelines.

limitations.en: Free Apprentice tier is strictly non-commercial and watermarks all renders.
Indie tier is gated by revenue and funding caps, and capped at 3 licenses per studio.

reason.en: Free, open-source 3D suite covering modeling, simulation and rendering, the main lower-cost alternative to Houdini for procedural and VFX work.
Competing 3D/motion graphics application with its own procedural and simulation toolset.
Industry-standard 3D animation and VFX package that overlaps with Houdini in film and game production pipelines.

unknowns: Public prices for Houdini Core and Houdini FX are not shown on their SideFX product pages or the Buy page as fetched; they require going through the interactive purchase flow or contacting SideFX directly.
Whether Houdini Indie offers a free trial period was not stated on the fetched pages.
